Name: Pumpkin Lantern
Design brief: One friendly squat jack-o-lantern prop, six broad orange lobes, thick curved green stem, triangular eyes and cheerful carved mouth with flat warm yellow interior. No light spill, particles, pedestal or floor.

Name: Haunted Crate
Design brief: One compact purple wooden decoration crate with chunky navy corner guards, broad crossed plank slats, two tiny lime eyes peeking from a narrow dark slit and a rounded cream padlock hanging on front. No hands or loose ghost.

Name: Lucky Pot
Design brief: One squat dark emerald pot with thick gold rim, two attached rounded side handles, a mound of large gold coin discs nestled inside and one raised clover emblem on front. No detached coins, rainbow or writing.

Name: Clover Arch
Design brief: One small freestanding chunky emerald festival arch with a thick horseshoe-shaped frame, two broad cream-and-gold weighted feet and three oversized gold clover ornaments attached along the top. No text or surrounding scene, full arch clearly visible.

Name: Festival Lantern
Design brief: One plump round red Lunar New Year paper lantern decoration with eight broad simple vertical ribs, thick gold top and bottom collars, short attached navy hanging loop and one compact stylized gold tassel ending in three broad strips. No calligraphy or thin strings.

Name: Lion Mask Stand
Design brief: One cheerful Lunar New Year lion-dance mask decoration mounted on a short wide red pedestal: chunky red and gold round mask, oversized cream circular eyes, rounded green nose, big friendly grin and broad white fluffy cheek shapes. One connected prop, no human, lettering or dangling filaments.

Name: Festive Tree
Design brief: One compact stylised evergreen Christmas tree in a squat red pot, three tiered chunky green cones with broad cream snow caps, five large attached gold/red round ornaments and a small attached golden star at the tip. No lights string, loose presents or scene.

Name: Snow Buddy
Design brief: One cute toy snowman decoration with two broad ivory snowballs, short navy hat, thick red scarf with ends attached to body, orange carrot nose and two short navy mitten arms. Flat stable base, no floor, snowflakes or text.

Name: Egg Basket
Design brief: One squat cream-and-tan woven Easter basket with one thick arched pink handle and three large painted pastel eggs nestled inside. Egg motifs are simple mint stripes and lavender dots. Solid shapes, no grass strands or detached eggs.

Name: Carrot Sign
Design brief: One playful freestanding Easter garden marker shaped like a giant orange carrot with three thick green leaf blades, supported on a short wide lavender base. A small raised cream rabbit-head silhouette inset on the carrot face, no lettering, no readable sign text.

Name: Party Balloon Cluster
Design brief: One connected birthday balloon decoration: three glossy chunky balloons in pink, cyan and gold attached by thick short curved rigid stems to one squat purple weighted star-shaped base. No fine strings or loose confetti. Entire self-contained prop visible.

Name: Birthday Cake Stand
Design brief: One celebratory birthday decoration consisting of a two-tier pastel pink and cream cake on a chunky cyan pedestal, broad frosting scallops, three thick attached gold candles with tiny solid orange flames. No text, age number, plate utensils or loose confetti.
